what: Article 14 swaps "Elderly" for "Senior" throughout the zoning bylaw, changes the "Elderly Household" definition and the parking rules for some senior housing, and stops allowing the existing Elderly Housing use in the General Commercial, Arterial Commercial and Mixed Commerce zones.
history: The Planning Board held a public hearing on the senior housing article Aug 26; the Select Board took a 4-1 vote on Article 14 at its Sep 22 meeting.
how_to_speak: Elected Town Meeting members vote. Other registered Plymouth voters may speak over Zoom with 48 hours' notice to the Town Moderator and a request to the Town Clerk.
line: Senior housing zoning update; no "Elderly Housing" in commercial zones: vote (Article 14).
quote: ARTICLE 14: Zoning Bylaw Amendment – Senior Housing To see if the Town will vote to amend the Zoning Bylaw by replacing the word “Elderly” with “Senior”, modifying the definition of “Elderly Household” in §201-3, modifying the parking table in §203-7 related to certain senior housing uses
when_time: Saturday, the Seventeenth day of October, 2026, at 8:00 a.m.
when_place: Plymouth North High School at 41 Obery Street in Plymouth, MA, and Zoom Webinar; the public can watch on The Local Seen (Comcast and Verizon) or thelocalseen.media/live
missing: What the Sep 22 Select Board motion was (recommend or not): cut off in our record. Full text on file with the Town Clerk.

line: Looser light-industrial building rules: height, setbacks, floor area. Vote (Article 15).

when_time: Saturday, the Seventeenth day of October, 2026, at 8:00 a.m.
when_place: Plymouth North High School at 41 Obery Street in Plymouth, MA, and Zoom Webinar; the public can watch on The Local Seen (Comcast and Verizon) or thelocalseen.media/live
